## Descripción
What happens if you have a small exponent? There is a twist though, we padded the plaintext so that (M∗∗e)(M∗∗e) is just barely larger than NN. Let's decrypt this: [values](https://challenge-files.cylabacademy.net/library/c38aad598cec5f49f44a9d3d52f971d09b1c834876274d278c5bfef04935fceb/values)
